## Annex 1 — Draft Manifestation (errata)

Caption: Patricia Keesey Zschoche, represented by her attorney-in-fact Jonathan Paul Zschoche, Plaintiff, v. Gloria H. Balane et al., Defendants. Civil Case No. 26-360, MTC Mercedes, Camarines Norte. For: Accion Reivindicatoria, Recovery of Possession, Declaration of Nullity of Deed of Absolute Sale, Cancellation of TCT No. 079-2021002126 and ARP No. GR-2023-II-07-001-00256, Accounting, and Damages.

**MANIFESTATION** (Re: Clerical Errors in the Judicial Affidavit of Plaintiff's Witness Jonathan Paul Zschoche)

PLAINTIFF, through the undersigned counsel, respectfully manifests:

1. Plaintiff's witness Jonathan Paul Zschoche executed a Judicial Affidavit sworn on 23 January 2026 at Daet, Camarines Norte.

2. The Judicial Affidavit contains the following clerical errors, which plaintiff corrects as follows: (a) in the Statement of Purposes, items (g) and (h), the date "September 26, 2019" should read "**September 29, 2016**", as shown by the Deed of Absolute Sale itself (Exhibit "H") and by Question and Answer Nos. 35 and 37 of the same Judicial Affidavit; (b) in the answers to Question Nos. 11 and 12, the area "28,981 square meters" should read "**28,891 square meters**", as shown by TCT No. T-52540 (Exhibit "B").

3. These are typographical errors that do not change the substance of the testimony. The correct date and area appear in the documentary exhibits attached to the Judicial Affidavit.

4. The witness will affirm these corrections under oath when he takes the witness stand.

WHEREFORE, plaintiff respectfully prays that this Honorable Court NOTE the foregoing corrections. Other reliefs just and equitable are likewise prayed for.

Daet, Camarines Norte, ____ October 2026. BARANDON LAW OFFICES, by Atty. Bonifacio T. Barandon, Jr. [Roll, IBP, PTR, MCLE]. Copy furnished: Atty. Ronald A. Ramos, Counsel for Defendants, 95 Vivencio St., Brgy. II, Daet. [Explanation of service, Rule 13 §11, if not personal.]
